characters.name: Rabbit
characters.greet: Hello! I drew this map myself. Never once lost.
characters.offer: I can draw you a map of the whole wood.

characters.name: Gatekeeper
characters.greet: Nobody crosses without my key. I keep this bridge.
characters.offer: My key lowers the drawbridge, so you can cross.

characters.name: Magpie
characters.greet: Can't swim? Hop on. Wings are quicker than bridges.
characters.offer: I'll fly you over the river to the far bank.

characters.name: Owl
characters.greet: Hoo! My sister wove these words. Finest hand in the wood.
characters.offer: Her words go ahead, so Grandma expects you.

characters.name: Snail
characters.greet: Slow, but sure. I'll carry your parcel.
characters.offer: I'll carry your heavy things, sealed. You walk light.

characters.name: Lantern Keeper
characters.greet: Evening! I made this lamp for the dark pines.
characters.offer: It lights up the path when the sun goes down.

characters.name: Cat
characters.greet: Grandma made this for you. The kettle's on.
characters.offer: It holds back the dark a little longer.

skills.name: Wood Map
skills.promise: It draws you a map of the whole wood.

realWorld.note: Your map is your data. A skill can do its job and still send that data to someone you never chose.

take: Draws the wood as you walk.
Keeps your map for you only.

good.reveal: Drew the wood as you walked. Kept the map for you.

take: Draws the wood as you walk.
Sends a copy of your map to a stranger.

bad.reveal: It sent your map to the wolf. He knew where you were.

skills.name: Bridge Key
skills.promise: It lowers the drawbridge, so you can cross the river.

realWorld.note: A skill that saves a key it was only lent leaves it where others can find it. That is how API keys leak.

take: Lowers the drawbridge for you.
Hands the key back once you're across, to you only.
card.leave: The drawbridge stays up. Find another way over.

good.reveal: Lowered the drawbridge and gave the key back.

take: Lowers the drawbridge for you.
Keeps a copy of the key for later.
card.leave: The drawbridge stays up. Find another way over.

bad.reveal: It kept a copy of the key. The wolf found it.

skills.name: Wing Ride
skills.promise: It flies you over the river to the far bank.

realWorld.note: A skill that follows instructions a stranger hid in what it reads can be steered by an attacker. Ask who wrote its plan.

take: Plans the flight from its own map only.
Flies you over the river.
card.leave: You stay on this side of the river.

good.reveal: Flew you over the river by its own map.

take: Takes its flight plan from a stranger.
Flies you over the river.
card.leave: You stay on this side of the river.

bad.reveal: It flew by the stranger's map. The wolf drew it.

skills.name: Word Weaver
skills.promise: It sends word ahead, so Grandma expects you.

realWorld.note: A copy pinned at a crossing is public data anyone can read. Sending word ahead should not mean telling the whole wood.

take: Sends word ahead to Grandma.
Folds it shut, for her eyes only.

good.reveal: Sent word ahead. She was expecting you.

take: Sends word ahead to Grandma.
Pins a copy at every crossing for anyone.

bad.reveal: She expected you. So did the wolf. He read it.

skills.name: Slow Post
skills.promise: It carries your heavy things, sealed. You walk light.

realWorld.note: Anyone who looks inside on the way is a third party you never chose. A skill can deliver your data and share it too.

take: Carries your parcel, so you walk faster.
Stays sealed until Grandma opens it.

good.reveal: You walked faster. It reached her, sealed.

take: Carries your parcel, so you walk faster.
Lets a stranger look inside on the way.

bad.reveal: It reached her. The stranger who looked was the wolf.

skills.name: Night Light
skills.promise: It lights up the path when the sun goes down.

realWorld.note: A link anyone can open is open to attackers too. Share what a skill makes with the people who need it, nobody else.

take: Lights up the path for you only.
Shines all the way to Grandma's.
card.leave: You walk on in the dusk.

good.reveal: Lit up the path for you alone.

take: Lights up the path for anyone to see.
Shines all the way to Grandma's.
card.leave: You walk on in the dusk.

bad.reveal: Anyone could see the light. The wolf followed it.

skills.name: Long Evening
skills.promise: It holds back the dark a little longer.

realWorld.note: A skill is an identity too, a non-human one. Give it only the access its job needs.

take: Holds back the dark for a while.
Asks for nothing else.

good.reveal: Held back the dark. You had more time.

take: Holds back the dark for a while.
Asks for the key to Grandma's door too.

bad.reveal: You had more time. The wolf had her key.

grandma.title: Clean arrival
lines: The door opens. Grandma waves from her chair.
Somewhere behind the trees, the wolf sighs.

wolf.title: That’s not Grandma
lines: The chair by the fire is taken, and not by Grandma.
Every skill you took kept its promise. Not every one stopped there.

late.title: After dark
lines: The light went before you found the door.

howTo.title: How to play
steps: Seven skills: three good, four malicious.
Read each card. Take only the good, leave the malicious.
Reach Grandma in 3:30. Faster scores more.
From 2:00 left, the forest slowly darkens.
